DT02.query: What are the conditions for claiming deduction under Section 80C? List qualifying instruments and the investment ceiling.

The qualifying instruments include employer and assessee contributions to pension schemes of the Central Government. The investment ceiling is Rs. 150,000.

DT03.query: Can a long-term capital loss be set off against short-term capital gains? What is the carry-forward period?
DT03.response: A long-term capital loss cannot be set off against short-term capital gains. Under Section 108 of the Income Tax Act 2025, LTCL can only be set off against LTCG. The carry-forward period is 8 tax years per Section 110.
